why: Django's ticket tracker forbids automated use of its own search (robots.txt: Disallow /search and /query). A web search engine's index of the tracker was searched instead, and each ticket it returned that bears on the subject was fetched by number, which robots.txt allows. An index does not hold every ticket, so this is not a full search of the tracker.

searches.tool: web search limited to the domain code.djangoproject.com
searches.query: site:code.djangoproject.com/ticket "PoolTimeout" OR "couldn't get a connection" psycopg pool postgresql
